_note: Version-controlled branch protection policy. Each key under branches is an exact branch name; its value is the exact payload sent to the protection endpoint, so what is reviewed in a pull request is byte-for-byte what gets applied. Add further exact branch names (for example a stable release branch) as new keys. Keep required_status_checks.contexts aligned with the check names your CI workflow actually reports; an empty list applies the remaining rules but enforces no checks.
